content.title: Tax Day 2026 deals: Where to find freebies and discounts on April 15
content.text: U.S. News Actions Facebook Tweet Email Tax Day 2026 deals: Where to find freebies and discounts on April 15 Prev Next Photo by: Debby Lowe/Shutterstock.com By: Scripps News Group Posted 3:26 PM, Apr 14, 2026 April 15 is Tax Day. It can bring plenty of stress, but some businesses are offering discounts and freebies to help ease the anxiety. Krispy KremeBuy a dozen doughnuts and get an Original Glazed dozen free with promo code TAXBREAK for online or in-app orders.Wendy’sGet a free 6-piece nuggets with a $5 purchase through the Wendy’s app.PopeyesTake 25% off a 3-piece tenders combo.QDOBA Rewards members who complete a short survey can unlock a $5 reward toward any full-sized entrée.IN CASE YOU MISSED IT | From dirty Dr. Pepper to dragon berry: McDonald’s expands drink menuPizza Hut Large three-topping pizzas are available for $10 when ordered online or through the app.7-ElevenUse code WRITEOFF to get $10.40 off any delivery order of $25 or more. HootersDine-in deal includes a $4.15 burger, $2.50 American draft beers and free kids meals.
